events.title: Hal is talking to the D.A.
events.body: Caught with 40 lbs of eels outside the visiting clubhouse, Hal says he was "just delivering." The D.A. offers him a deal if he names who he was delivering for.

events.title: An Offer You Could Refuse
events.body: bobbys_cousin wants you in The Corkers syndicate. Shared crews, shared treasury, shared bail.

events.title: Bobby wants a word
events.body: Bobby noticed your crew in his bullpen. He's not mad. He wants 20% of whatever you're running on the Friars.

choices.label: Tell him to take a hike
